input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 lets either Party terminate on ninety (90) days' written notice against a one-year auto-renewing term, so the notice mechanics sit at the fallback (Customer exit on 90 days; HDI effectively limited to end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days) and we do not redline them. The material failure is Section 4.2(a): any Company termination triggers a Termination Payment equal to 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments. That is an uncapped exit penalty that can run to many multiples of three months' fees (fees are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month), and it is expressed to apply to every Company termination, including simple non-renewal, termination under Section 1.6 for HDI's failure to launch the Site, and termination for HDI's breach. The fallback permits an early-termination fee only up to three months' fees, so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. Given the pure revenue-share bargain (HDI builds and hosts the Site with no upfront fees), eliminating any payment entirely would be disproportionate, so we have taken the fallback: cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 payments and disapply it to non-renewal, Section 1.6 and HDI-breach terminations.

proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it to non-renewal and terminations arising from HDI's failure.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We are content with the 90 days' notice in Section 4.1, but the Termination Payment as drafted is an uncapped exit penalty (50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000) payable whenever we terminate, including on simple non-renewal or where HDI is at fault. Our playbook allows an early-termination fee only up to three months' fees, so we have capped it accordingly and confirmed it does not apply to non-renewal or to termination under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement for convenience prior to the end of the then-current term, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided, that in no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate payments made by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) months immediately preceding the Termination Date. No Termination Payment shall be due or payable where the Company terminates this Agreement by notice of non-renewal under Section 4.1, pursuant to Section 1.6, or by reason of HDI's breach of this Agreement.
